items.name: c-message-scroller-1
items.title: Chat transcript with jump to latest
items.description: A scroll region that opens at the live edge with a jump to latest control.
items.descriptionLong: Chat transcript with jump to latest. Built by composing Avatar, Bubble, Card, Message, Message Scroller. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-message-scroller-2
items.title: Streaming reply that follows the edge
items.description: autoScroll pins the viewport while tokens arrive, and releases the moment the reader scrolls up.
items.descriptionLong: Streaming reply that follows the edge. Built by composing Avatar, Badge, Bubble, Button, Card and 3 more. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-message-scroller-3
items.title: Anchored turn with a previous peek
items.description: scrollAnchor lifts a sent message near the top while a slice of the previous turn stays visible.
items.descriptionLong: Anchored turn with a previous peek. Built by composing Avatar, Bubble, Card, Input Group, Message and 1 more. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-3 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-message-scroller-4
items.title: Opening position for a saved thread
items.description: Compare start, end and last-anchor as the place a reopened thread opens at.
items.descriptionLong: Opening position for a saved thread. Built by composing Bubble, Card, Marker, Message, Message Scroller and 1 more. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-4 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-message-scroller-5
items.title: Load earlier without losing your place
items.description: Older turns prepend above the reader while the row they were reading stays put.
items.descriptionLong: Load earlier without losing your place. Built by composing Avatar, Badge, Bubble, Button, Card and 4 more. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-5 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-message-scroller-6
items.title: Thread navigator for stepping turns
items.description: A footer navigator that reports the turn you are reading and jumps between turns.
items.descriptionLong: Thread navigator for stepping turns. Built by composing Avatar, Bubble, Button, Card, Message and 1 more. A free, open source shadcn message scroller example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-message-scroller-6 and edit as your own code.
